text: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk, played Tuesdays with Paul as DM. Each session opens with a Question of the Day and a recap, and the recapper earns Heroic Inspiration.
A long-lost dwarven and gnomish mine rediscovered by the Rockseeker brothers. Phandalin was a booming trade center when the forge was active centuries ago.

A green flame that has burned for about 500 years and lends magic drawn up from the cave. Blades and armor held in it gain a borrowed enchantment (a plain dagger became +1) that fades after about 8 hours. It doesn't work on rings, and it currently runs at about a quarter of its potential.
A spectator was summoned for 101 years under a contract signed by Halvard Price in 1385. It expired about five years before the current year, 1491.
Loosely linked cells that oppose tyranny.
The animated remains of a spellcaster that keeps casting after death. It reforms within hours unless its remains are purified with holy water.
Telepathic aberrations. This one was smaller and less developed than expected. Its slime made Francis unable to rest or heal by nonmagical means.
The Tresendar crypt skeletons ignore anyone wearing a red cloak.
Klarg answered to King Grol, who answered to the Spider. Yeemik said he follows power wherever it's strongest.
Agatha held it, grew bored of its secrets, and traded it over a century ago to someone "of Erebor". The name was recorded as both Tsarnaev and Samber.
Talon is a legendary blade tied to Aldith Tresendar of the family whose manor the party now owns.
Lathander (Solas is his herald, and his statue stands in Cragmaw's shrine), Tyr (Francis's shield), and the Earth Mother/Chauntea (Caine).
